title: Funding Level Loading by Eligible Headcount — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** An employer whose live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement shows an eligible headcount of at least 500 adds 15 percent to the funding level of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, one showing at least 100 adds 5 percent, and any other employer adds nothing for headcount.

The eligible headcount is the number of eligible employees on the latest monthly census, as recorded on the employer's live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement.

| Eligible headcount on the live agreement | Loading |
|---|---|
| 500 or more | 15 percent |
| 100 to 499 | 5 percent |
| fewer than 100 | nothing |
| no live agreement | nothing |

Boundary pairs: 500 adds 15 percent and 499 adds 5 percent; 100 adds 5 percent and 99 adds nothing.
